Patch Set 1:

(5 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The generation check makes the double ll_imp_inval race from LU-21226 less likely but doesn't seem to close it, and the commit message gets wrong what a generation change means. It may be more robust to make the LUSTRE_IMP_EVICTED branch of ptlrpc_import_recovery_state_machine() start only one invalidate thread per eviction, decided under imp_lock (for example by moving the state on, or checking imp_inval_count, before kthread_run()), so that no caller can start a second one.

Uploaded patch set 2.

commit.message:
LU-21226 ldlm: skip recovery state machine

if import's generation has changed (meaning ldlm lock replay failed
and reconnection was initiated), otherwise we'll enter the recovery
state machine and race with reconnection.
